leads.title: Hamby v. Parnell
leads.documents: Federal district court ruling that declared Alaska's statutory and constitutional bans on same-sex marriage unconstitutional, making same-sex marriage legal in Alaska
leads.detail: U.S. District Court in Anchorage, Judge Timothy Burgess; filed May 12, 2014 by five same-sex couples; oral argument Oct 10, 2014; ruled Oct 12, 2014; licenses accepted Oct 13, 2014

leads.title: Bostock v. Clayton County, consolidated with Altitude Express, Inc. v. Zarda and R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes Inc. v. EEOC
leads.documents: U.S. Supreme Court ruling that workplace discrimination on basis of sexual orientation or gender identity is sex discrimination under Title VII, protecting LGBT employees despite lack of Alaska state employment law

leads.title: Matthew Shepard and James Byrd, Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act
leads.documents: Federal hate-crimes law providing penalty enhancements for crimes motivated by actual or perceived sexual orientation or gender identity, allowing federal prosecution in Alaska
leads.detail: Signed into law October 2009 by President Barack Obama; cited because Alaska state hate-crime law does not cover gender identity or sexual orientation

leads.title: Alaska Board of Education rule on transgender participation in female sports
leads.documents: Statewide rule banning transgender individuals from participating in female sports and athletics

leads.title: Anchorage municipal LGBTQ anti-discrimination ordinances and Proposition 1
leads.documents: City-level ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing and public accommodations, and voter retention of transgender protections
leads.detail: Assembly passed 2009 7-4 vetoed by Mayor Dan Sullivan; Proposition 5 rejected April 2012 57% opposed; Assembly passed September 2015 9-2 with Mayor Ethan Berkowitz; Proposition 1 to strip transgender protections rejected April 3, 2018 by 53% to 47%

leads.title: Ketchikan City Council anti-discrimination ordinance
leads.documents: Local ban on unfair discrimination on account of sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing and public accommodations
leads.detail: Passed unanimously July 2020, taking effect mid-August 2020

leads.title: Anchorage conversion therapy ban ordinance
leads.documents: City ban on use of conversion therapy on minors
leads.detail: Passed August 2020 by vote 9-2; first city in Alaska to do so

leads.title: Alaska Department of Vital Records Birth Certificate Request policy and Division of Motor Vehicles gender-marker policy
leads.documents: Administrative requirements for transgender persons to amend birth certificate name/gender marker and driver's license gender marker
leads.detail: Requires Birth Certificate Request Form, photocopy of ID, letter from medical/mental health provider attesting clinical treatment for gender transition or certified court-ordered change of sex plus fee; amended certificate still shows former name; DMV requires provider letter or updated birth certificate or court order

leads.title: Public Religion Research Institute (PRRI) polls on Alaska
leads.documents: Statewide public opinion on same-sex marriage, anti-discrimination law covering sexual orientation and gender identity, and religious refusals
leads.detail: 2017 poll: 57% support same-sex marriage, 65% support anti-discrimination law, 52% oppose religious refusal; 2022 poll: 70% support same-sex marriage, 78% support anti-discrimination law

leads.title: Alaska's Equality Profile - via the Movement Advancement Project
leads.documents: Institutional equality profile summarizing LGBTQ legal status in Alaska
leads.detail: Listed in External links as 'Alaska's Equality Profile – via the Movement Advancement Project'
